data.gender_notes: Harooni is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harooni is an Arabic name derived from Harun, meaning 'high exalted one'. It is also associated with Aaron, the brother of Prophet Musa (Moses) in Islamic tradition. The name Harooni carries the meaning “High Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Harooni usually hope their child will grow to embody high exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaron, the brother of Prophet Musa, was known for his wisdom and faith. The name Harooni carries a similar spiritual significance, symbolizing wisdom, faith, and leadership.
data.etymology: Harooni belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harooni total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

In the context of Arab culture, it is a common name for boys that evokes feelings of nobility, harmony, and exaltedness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Harooni holds a significant spiritual meaning as it is derived from the name of Aaron, who was a close companion and confidant to Prophet Moses. Aaron was a pious and righteous man who played an essential role in the delivery of the Ten Commandments to the Israelites. In Islam, Aaron is considered an exalted figure, and the name Harooni is a reminder of his ongoing spiritual influence. The name embodies the ideals of humility, knowledge, and faithfulness, as well as a powerful connection to the sacred roots of monotheistic traditions.
